cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")

Lina (docs): added. Anya, quant one-liner?
Anya (opt): "Use int8 for throughput-focused batch workloads; use fp16/bf16 for latency-sensitive short inputs. Run a 50-sample smoke eval before rollout."
Lina (docs): batching JSON (copy/paste):```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
    "min_requests": 2,
    "timeout_ms": 20
  }
}
```
Vik (eng): note: if p95 spikes, try timeout_ms=10 and lower max_batch_tokens. Also add SSE header example for streaming requests.
Lina (docs): added SSE example and a 3-step checklist: 1) run 20-50 sample smoke eval, 2) enable kv-prefetch on high-prefix routes, 3) tune batching or set to auto.
